knownIssues.symptom: The launcher (AssettoCorsa.exe, .NET/WPF) shows 'Configuration system failed to initialize' and exits; the game itself never starts from Steam's Play.
acs.exe exits immediately with no error and no log when started directly.
On D3DMetal the session dies on Start with a Metal assertion, a texture of width and height 4294967295 (reported on a 13-inch M1 with 8 GB, macOS 26.6.2, highball#94)

notes: See the upstream recipe for its full Highball setup.
